title: Oxchibus
description: ‘Oxford Chinese Businesses’ or ‘OXCHIBUS’ is a website dedicated to recording the history of the Chinese community in Oxfordshire, England. OXCHIBUS aims to record the history of Chinese owned businesses in Oxford between the year 1910 and 1990’s.

title: Pokedex
description: A recreation of the Pokemon Brilliant Diamond pokedex. Utilises custom made SVGs for certain assets for the scrollbar, background etc. The application uses the PokeApi to gather data for the pokedex. (Desktop only)

title: CS50x Final Project
description: The CS50 marketplace is my final project for CS50x. It is a simple e-commerce store for secondhand or homemade products. This is a fullstack application using Vue and Flask

title: Lol Stats Checker
description: LolStatsChecker is an app to search up League of Legends. The Riot api isn't accessible with calls to the frontend and require a secret key in order to work, therefore flask is used to handle the api calls, package and send information back to the frontend. The project allows you to search up any League of Legends username, select a region and show details of that players match history/level and etc.
